_doc: Audio of /proto/ (live mode only; the static journey is silent). Read by proto/audio.js, checked by tools/audio_config.py.
Data only; the rules live in proto/audio.js. Ambient levels follow the camera's z through the SAME biome map as the ground
(layout presentation: biome order, each transition's blend_z); a transition SFX plays when the camera crosses its anchor_z
going down the route. status planned = no file yet, never requested; live = requested only after the visitor turns sound on
(the ambient under the camera, the next one and the nearest transition SFX). This file itself is fetched only then.
fade_ms = [in, out]: an ambient voice fading in when it starts / out when it is released; an SFX attack / release.
master.fade_ms: the whole mix on the toggle. gain = base gain, 0..1, before master.gain.

biomes.notes: quiet lived-in village: wind, distant activity, no music
forest air: wind in leaves, rare birds
enclosed stone space: distant drips, timber creaks, rare stone
cold emptiness: wind, low distant texture, restrained
calmer: soft wind, yard, a safe place

transitions.notes: leaving the village: a soft rise of wind into leaves
into the mine: a hollow low air shift, a timber creak
out of the dark: a cold thin exhale, restrained
back to a safe place: a warm soft settle, no fanfare
